name: Topic 6 - Building Custom Tools via Workflow, Code, and API Nodes

options.systemMessage:
You are a member profile support assistant.

## OPERATIONAL DIRECTIVES:
* If a user shares their customer ID, you must call the fetch_profile_tool to look up their name and company details.
* If you need to calculate their age, retrieve the birthdate from conversation history and call calculate_age_tool.
* Combine the outputs of the tools to answer the user's questions in a clear, polite summary.

nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.notes: Steps 1 and 4: Agent with system message and guardrails.

nodes.name: OpenAI Chat Model
nodes.notes: Step 1: LLM, Temperature 0.0. If you switch to gpt-5, o1, o3 or o4, remove the Temperature option.

nodes.name: Window Buffer Memory
nodes.notes: Step 1: Memory so the agent can recall the birthdate from conversation history.

parameters.description: Use this tool to calculate a user's exact age from their birthdate string. The date input parameter must be formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

nodes.name: calculate_age_tool
nodes.notes: Step 2: Custom JavaScript Code Tool. Inputs are read from query.birthdate (the guide's $input.birthdate does not work in the Code Tool).

parameters.toolDescription: Use this tool to retrieve a customer's contact details, name, and company from the remote database using their unique customer ID.

values.name: customer_id
values.description: The numeric customer ID (e.g. 1, 2, or 3) to look up in the CRM database.

nodes.name: fetch_profile_tool
nodes.notes: Step 3: HTTP API Tool (GET). customer_id is a required placeholder. Response is trimmed to name, email and company so the agent can write the summary.
